description: A copy of the r-fmt-2b-w-accdb fixture (123 pages; page 122, Au4's old data page, is the only free page inside the file). Au1: tdef 107, usage maps 108, PK root 109, ten rows (IDs 1-10, 21-23 bytes) on data page 110. One shared session opens a table-type recordset on Au1 and runs Delete then MoveNext three times, the recordset's RecordCount read after each; after a 1.5 s pause the pages. The recordset closes (pause, pages), then the database (pages). TableDefs("Au1").RecordCount is read before the Deletes and after each, every read after TableDefs.Refresh. Asks whether Refresh brings the TableDef's count up to date. Each read keeps page 0 bytes 3584-3591 and pages 1, 107, 108, 109, 110, 122; after Close every page's hash too.
retentionNote: r-q19-growth-open (zfrp stretch 4 open growth cases): designed probe, one element varied; answers kept with their page bytes
